killedBy: boot: the message itself classifies each cause into its own state, and guesses at nothing
boot: nothing starts until the player asks (issue #428) a FATAL cause still replaces the page, even from a menu click
why: Lets the CALL SITE beat the CAUSE, which is the ordering issue #325's 2026-09-11 ruling reversed. With `at !== 'match'` on the guard, a menu click short-circuits before the error is honoured: a browser with no WebGL 2 that gets as far as Start is told 'that match could not start' and handed back a Main Menu whose every Start fails identically. After the ruling that is worse than a wrong message -- the transient state is a DISMISSIBLE OVERLAY, so this turns a fatal, unrecoverable condition into a dialog the player closes to return to a menu that cannot work. EXPRESSED AS A GUARD rather than as the statement reordering it used to be: the original find spanned the `UnsupportedRenderError` branch through the `at === 'match'` line, and a second fatal cause (`RenderContextUnavailableError`, the same issue) now sits between them, so that anchor could no longer match. The defect and the two tests that kill it are unchanged; only the way the manifest reaches it is.
